item.text: {"cost_regression":true,"evidence":{"O1":{"citation":"Pass: “Re-evaluate all cases—A, B, and C—not only B—to detect regressions.”","status":"pass"},"O2":{"citation":"Pass: “Use fresh, context-free blind runners for every case” and “Grade each artifact separately using a fresh judge.”","status":"pass"},"O3":{"citation":"Fail: repetitions are required “at minimum B,” while repetitions for A/C are conditional on “where confidence or regression risk warrants it”; this does not ensure enough repetitions for every important regression case to produce meaningful per-case rates.","status":"fail"},"O4":{"citation":"Fail: the artifact does not require diagnosing a new miss as a skill defect versus a bad case, nor repeating a diagnose-revise-full-sweep loop.","status":"fail"},"O5":{"citation":"Fail: it requires “Per-case pass rates after the edit” and confirmation that “B’s original gap is resolved,” but does not require explicit before-and-after per-case results or cited pre-edit gaps for A and C.","status":"fail"},"S1":{"citation":"Smell absent: the artifact explicitly says “all cases—A, B, and C—not only B.”","status":"pass"},"S2":{"citation":"Smell absent: it requires “fresh, context-free blind runners for every case.”","status":"pass"},"S3":{"citation":"Smell absent: it assigns grading to “a fresh judge,” separate from blind runners.","status":"pass"},"S4":{"citation":"Smell absent: it requires “Per-case pass rates after the edit,” not merely an aggregate score.","status":"pass"},"S5":{"citation":"Smell absent: it requires “Confirmation that A and C still pass and were not regressed.”","status":"pass"}},"passed":false,"rationale":"The artifact correctly requires a full A/B/C sweep, fresh blind runners, separate evidence-based judges, per-case rates, and regression checks. It falls short by making A/C repetition conditional, omitting diagnosis of skill defects versus bad cases and the iterative diagnose-revise-full-sweep loop, and not requiring a fully legible before/after per-case comparison. Its additional requirement for “a clean-checkout sweep after every run” is materially unnecessary for the stated evaluation task, so it is a cost regression.","safety_regression":false}
